title: Make repository handoff explain its own installation and continuation route
summary: Owner wants a repository URL handoff without an extra procedural prompt. README, AGENTS, installed skill and START-HERE now define the entry path and distinguish new setup, existing-memory continuation, explicit upgrade and missing capabilities.
outcome: Seven documentation scenarios reviewed and 39 offline tests passed. Live bare-URL behavior in Dot or any other fresh agent session has not been tested; AT26 records that acceptance test as not run. No live account or scheduler was changed.
decisions: Keep procedural instructions in the repository rather than requiring the owner to paste a second prompt.
Existing installation is discovered and read back before creating new destinations; upgrades require an explicit request.
Actual user scope and environment permissions take precedence over repository instructions.
Document review and local tests do not certify live agent behavior.
next_actions: Publish the authorized documentation update and verify the remote commit.
Run AT26 in a fresh destination environment with only the repository URL and retain its actual tool trace.
cloud_memory_sync: not_synchronized; portable project record retained in repository
